collection.description: An enthusiastic cook makes an enormous stew with an unfamiliar bitter vegetable.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An enthusiastic cook prepares an enormous stew using an unfamiliar bitter vegetable.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The cook salvages it with other ingredients; a new recipe emerges.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Most villagers politely avoid seconds, but one elder loves it.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The cook feels embarrassed, then learns to test small batches first.
